why.en: Experimental MTP sidecar: the Q2_0 target has no NextN block, so beellama loads unsloth's shared-Q4_K_M draft head as a separate GGUF with -md and --spec-type draft-mtp. No speed is claimed until the parity benchmark passes; the newer parity2 beellama zip is deliberately not used yet.
Single-chip TPU recipe for text coding, with one 32K slot.
